decisions: Slot model is pure Python in services/view_layout.py (ViewLayout, 25 slots); CameraGrid owns it and persists 'grid_slots' via controller.config_store; no controller changes.
One VideoTile per camera kept (tiles() contract unchanged); empty positions are EmptySlotTile (objectName 'emptySlot', 'Empty' + hint, never streams).
Placing a camera that already has a slot always swaps (also with a hidden slot beyond n*n), so a camera is never in two slots and moves between visible slots do not restart streams.

Known-vs-new cameras: cameras present at startup but absent from a saved list stay hidden; cameras appearing later via cameras_changed fill the first empty slot (of 25). A non-list setting falls back to list order; bad entries become empty slots.
Add to view: first empty visible slot, else the slot of the last selected visible tile (kept even when a hidden row is selected, e.g. by the right-click), else the last visible slot.
Hidden rows in cameraList: italic + dimmed + tooltip line; text and status suffixes unchanged; IN_VIEW_ROLE (UserRole+2) = bool.
Drag payload MIME 'application/x-tapo-camera-id' (camera id, UTF-8, validated); cameraList is a QListWidget subclass (CameraListWidget) overriding mimeData.
Tiles: min size 96x54 (5x5 fits next to both docks), font sizes scale with tile size (overlay_font_sizes), name elided (display_name). Decode sizes unchanged (SD 640x360 in grid).

Menus are built by CameraGrid.slot_menu(index) / MainWindow.camera_list_menu(id) with objectNames (removeFromViewAction, showCameraMenu, showCamera_<id>, fullScreenAction, addToViewAction) so tests trigger QActions directly.
open_issues: docs/CONTRACT_UI.md does not yet describe grid_slots / menus / drag and drop (orchestrator-owned); behaviour is documented in the grid.py, main_window.py and view_layout.py docstrings.
Real mouse drag (QDrag.exec) is not exercised in offscreen tests; the drop handlers and payloads are.
